priorities.summary: An easily exploited flaw in Oracle Access Manager's authentication engine lets an unauthenticated attacker over the network take over the system and reach all data it can access, with scope to affect other products. Oracle's November patch fixes both affected releases - apply it now.
priorities.plain: Oracle Access Manager lets anyone on the network take over the login system without signing in; apply Oracle's patch now.

priorities.summary: BISHENG before 3.0.0 uses a hard-coded default secret to sign its login tokens, so an unauthenticated attacker can forge a token naming themselves an administrator and walk in. Upgrade to 3.0.0 or later, which removes the flaw.
priorities.plain: BISHENG lets anyone on the network sign in as an administrator without a password; upgrade to version 3.0.0 now.

priorities.summary: A format-string flaw in OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 lets an unauthenticated attacker run code on the server by publishing a location with a crafted tracker ID. Upgrade to 1.0.5 now.
priorities.plain: OwnTracks Recorder lets anyone on the network run code on the tracking server; upgrade to version 1.0.5 now.

model.name: GPT-6.2 Astra
model.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on November 17, its new flagship model for demanding reasoning, coding and professional work, now available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API at lower prices than its predecessor.
model.plain: OpenAI's new flagship AI for hard coding, research and document work, now available to businesses through ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.
